notes.title: 📢 Update 1.4.92 — Original Set Information for Zeptocosmos
notes.content:
Update 1.4.92 — Original Set Information for Zeptocosmos

What’s new:  
- Added Original Set information in the Level Info tab, accessible from the menu options while playing, for puzzles originally created by Aymeric.  
- This helps you identify puzzles from Aymeric’s collections, even though they have been sorted by difficulty and redistributed across new stages in Sokoboxes Duo.  
- Updated the About section to display Version: 1.4.92.

About Zeptocosmos:  
Zeptocosmos is a special collection of 40 exclusive puzzles created by Aymeric. For Sokoboxes Duo, these puzzles — along with others from Aymeric’s sets — were reorganized by difficulty and distributed into new stages with different names to fit the game’s design.  
This update makes it easy to check the puzzle’s original source: simply open the menu options during a level and look under the Level Info tab for the Original Set label.

Zeptocosmos puzzles appear in these stages and numbers:

  
Venus: 34, 35, 36, 37  
Earth: 27, 28, 29, 30  
Moon: 33, 34, 35, 36, 37  
Mars: 30, 31, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37, 38  
Jupiter: 16, 17, 18, 19, 20, 21  
Saturn: 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18  
Uranus: 13, 14, 15, 16  
Neptune: 2, 3  


Use the Original Set info in Level Info to confirm you’re playing a Zeptocosmos puzzle and enjoy this exclusive collection!
